name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash B300 (all-in-one)
notes: All-in-one image: model + vLLM 0.26 + FlashInfer cubins baked in. No volume, no start command — the image entrypoint serves and prints the endpoint + API key to the pod log.

Served from a Cloudflare R2-backed registry (dsv4-registry.lukaloehr.com). The ~185 GB pull is public and NOT rate-limited — no registry credential needed. Deploy: runpodctl pod create --template-id <id> --gpu-id 'NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC' --data-center-ids EU-NL-1.
Why not GHCR: its blob endpoint throttles fast parallel pulls (sub-second retry-after, ~22% of blob requests, IP-independent), and RunPod's puller aborts on the first 429. See cloudflare/README.md.
runpod/create-template.sh creates this template; ops/ builds the image and cloudflare/push-to-r2.sh mirrors it into R2.
